notes.title: The Razorform - News Update #1
notes.notes:
Hey all,



First off, thank you for your support. The Razorform announcement was a success, in that 1) the game was announced and 2) you're here reading this! 



I plan on providing regular updates, and this is the first one.


If you haven't already: Please WISHLIST THE RAZORFORM
Wishlists are critical in helping support the game's development. So if you already have the game on your wishlist, thank you so much!



Ok on to the news update...


News Update on News Updates

Playtesting plan
The Razorform is currently playable and it's actually very fun. I've logged over 80 hours of playtime (which is a lot for me, most games I play for 4 hours max). I can't wait to have you all play it. That said, there are no public builds yet, but I'm working hard to get there. I plan on doing some internal beta testing in October, with public playtests happening soon after.


Developer Roadmap
I'm currently building a roadmap to provide more information on upcoming milestones and what features are to be expected. I also will make some posts featuring the gameplay, how the game works, why it's fun, etc.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45691600/5ce04f857e0a8325eafbab044f95299d9e689341.png"]

Alright, that's all for this week. Thank you again for your support! Talk to you all soon.



Please consider following me on social media. I'm quite active on X and love engaging with people there (links below). You can also see additional game video and screenshots (although the screenshot above is a News Update exclusive.)



Cheers!
